laws.title: Governance remains external to governed payloads
laws.rule: R0.6 governance Records MUST classify already-defined Records without adding visibility, disclosure or maturity fields to any frozen R0.2 through R0.5 payload schema.

laws.title: Disclosure has logical target and exact basis
laws.rule: A governance.disclosure Record MUST identify one durable target through RecordRef and MUST bind each policy revision to one exact revision of that same RecordId through PinnedRecordRef.

laws.title: Record visibility is independent
laws.rule: Record visibility MUST state only whether the governed Record may participate in public projection and MUST NOT imply source availability, Evidence availability or maturity.

laws.title: Source availability is independent
laws.rule: Source availability MUST describe only the public availability classification of implementation or source material and MUST NOT determine Record visibility, Evidence availability or maturity.

laws.title: Evidence availability is independent
laws.rule: Evidence availability MUST describe only the public availability classification of evidential material and MUST NOT determine Record visibility, source availability, truth or maturity.

laws.title: Unknown remains unknown
laws.rule: The values unknown, none, private and not-applicable MUST remain semantically distinct and MUST NOT be inferred from one another when source or Evidence availability is absent or unresolved.

laws.title: Disclosure form is separate from visibility
laws.rule: Disclosure mode MUST specify full, sanitized, metadata-only or withheld public form and MUST remain a separate axis from the public or private Record visibility classification.

laws.title: Private requires withheld
laws.rule: A governance.disclosure payload with private Record visibility MUST use withheld disclosure and MUST NOT authorize full, sanitized or metadata-only public projection.

laws.title: Public cannot be withheld
laws.rule: A governance.disclosure payload with public Record visibility MUST use full, sanitized or metadata-only disclosure and MUST NOT remain ambiguously classified as withheld.

laws.title: Sanitized is an admission boundary
laws.rule: Sanitized disclosure MUST mean that the admitted target revision is already a bounded public-safe representation and MUST NOT authorize automatic retrieval, transformation or publication of private source material.

laws.title: Policy does not silently inherit across target revisions
laws.rule: A current disclosure or maturity classification MUST match the exact current target revision through basisRef and MUST become unclassified when the target advances without a matching governance revision.

laws.title: Current governance conflicts fail closed
laws.rule: Multiple distinct current governance Records classifying the same exact target revision MUST produce conflict and MUST NOT be resolved by recency, file order, permissiveness or route precedence.

laws.title: Withdrawn governance does not classify current state
laws.rule: Current governance projection MUST count only active or archived governance Records and MUST exclude withdrawn or tombstoned governance heads while retaining their historical lineage.

laws.title: Public projection requires current disclosure
laws.rule: A target MUST be public-projectable only when its current lifecycle is active or archived and exactly one current matching disclosure classifies the Record as public with a non-withheld disclosure mode.

laws.title: Governance target identity is constitutive
laws.rule: One governance.disclosure or governance.maturity lineage MUST preserve targetRef.recordId across successors; changing the governed logical target MUST create another governance Record.

laws.title: Maturity is separate from disclosure
laws.rule: A governance.maturity stage MUST classify System development state independently from Record visibility, disclosure mode, source availability and Evidence availability.

laws.title: Maturity applies only to Systems
laws.rule: R0.6 maturity governance MUST target only knowledge.system Records and MUST NOT impose System maturity stages on Questions, Investigations, Experiments, Claims, Evidence or representations.

laws.title: Maturity is not Evidence
laws.rule: A maturity stage including production MUST NOT by itself establish deployment, runtime behavior, test success, security, correctness or any other evidential Claim governed by R0.4.

laws.title: Maturity is non-monotonic
laws.rule: Maturity stages MAY move in any direction through accepted governance revisions and MUST NOT be interpreted as a monotonic truth, quality or permanence ordering.

laws.title: Route, language and migration remain separate
laws.rule: R0.6 MUST NOT define slug, route, canonical URL, redirect, language, translation, locale, legacy migration or final UI semantics assigned to R0.7, R0.8 and R1.

payload.rationale: Public-safe representation with private source and partially public evidence.
The system is under active investigation and is not represented as production.
